findings.statement: impl verdict uses effective policy from record classification on HEAD (profiles, risk_level); the PR can hand-edit classification (drop factory-change, lower risk) and weaken its own merge gates - the self-authorization that roles from HEAD^1 prevent.
findings.recommendation: In impl and archive require HEAD classification not stale vs classify of the PR diff (profiles superset, risk >= floor), else RECORD_MISMATCH; add SCN.

findings.statement: archive bullet: diff openspec/specs/** SHALL equal replay of openspec archive - unconditional, while kind archive includes change_state MERGED. A PR with new MERGED only: replay changes specs, diff has none -> SPECS_NOT_ARCHIVED, against the Paths rule tied to new ARCHIVED.
findings.recommendation: Replay only with new ARCHIVED in diff; otherwise specs in diff -> SCOPE_VIOLATION. Add SCN for a MERGED-only PR.

findings.statement: M for MERGED ref is found only via ci records in evidence[]. A Change whose VERIFYING->MERGED has no ci evidence (L0-only pack, NOT_APPLICABLE by applies_when) always gets REF_NOT_VERIFIED merge_commit and ci fetch NO_CI_EVIDENCE, though transition MERGED accepts it.
findings.recommendation: No ci records: M = merge commit of the ref PR on first-parent line of HEAD^1 whose diff changes this record; ci fetch: nothing to fetch, code 0.

findings.statement: APPROVED ref: merge commit of the spec-PR is not required to be in HEAD^1 history; a spec-PR merged by a maintainer into a side branch satisfies the check.
findings.recommendation: Require the merge commit on first-parent line of HEAD^1.

findings.statement: Record rules miss a diff that edits a record frozen in base (ARCHIVED, ABANDONED) without new transitions: prefix holds, ci passes; 04 and ADR-0021 say the file is immutable.
findings.recommendation: Frozen record changed in diff -> RECORD_MISMATCH.

findings.statement: Record rule reads evidence[] files at .warrant/evidence on HEAD, impl writes to <state>; with WARRANT_STATE_DIR (D-2) every new transition is RECORD_MISMATCH and the artifact leaves the working copy.
findings.recommendation: State that ci uses .warrant and ignores or rejects WARRANT_STATE_DIR.

findings.statement: attestation.ref without /attempts/ (allowed by REQ-VER-001) has no defined attempt for artifact evidence-<change>-<attempt> in the archive check and for URL of the attempt in ci fetch.
impl: records of kinds which checks do not produce - checks of VERIFYING->MERGED or any check of the pack is not said; the readings differ for kinds produced by checks of other transitions.
findings.recommendation: Name the set: kinds produced by checks of VERIFYING->MERGED.

assumptions.statement: N44 narrowed, N48, N49 are maintainer decisions and not findings
core-sdd tests-passed is non-waivable and ci-only, so F-3 hits other packs, not core-sdd
Fixes of review 5 (F-1..F-8) checked and hold
